name: adapter_state_word

ownership.argument: ADAPTER_STATE_WORD = 0x2013DBE8; ADAPTER_READY_STATE = 4. Both come from the producer, not from a consumer.

provenance.source: Byte holding the last adapter state. Written by adapter_bring_up 0xCA40ED4 with byte_2013DBE8 = state and read there in the same expression that decides whether the adapter just became ready: if (state == 4 && byte_2013DBE8 != 4) it logs 'on_adapter_state_on'.

notes: ADAPTER_STATE_WORD = 0x2013DBE8; ADAPTER_READY_STATE = 4. Both come from the producer, not from a consumer.
